_comment: The column length of a string-stored field.enum, per port. Each case is the `enums` block of a project's .metaobjects/config.json (null: no block). Each port reads it with its own config reader, puts it on the loaded meta.enums.json root, and resolves every Ticket enum's length through its core resolver (resolveEnumMaxLength and its per-port equivalents). null in `lengths` means no length: an unbounded text column. `overflow` cases must be refused when the named field's length is resolved, with ERR_ENUM_VALUE_EXCEEDS_MAX_LENGTH. Each `invalid` block must be refused when the config is read.

cases.name: no enums block: only an explicit @maxLength sizes a column
an empty block is the same as none
the project default sizes every enum without its own @maxLength

overflow.name: a member longer than the project default is refused

invalid.name: maxLength is a positive integer, not zero
maxLength is a number, not a string
